title: Identify schools in counties with the highest number of closed schools that
question: Identify schools in counties with the highest number of closed schools that are locally funded charter schools, serve a K–8 grade span, and have a free meal eligibility rate (K–12) above the average for such schools. Return the school name, city, and its free meal eligibility percentage.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s."XCL_041" AS school_id,
    s."XCL_045" AS county,
    s."XCL_047" AS school_name,
    s."XCL_050" AS city,
    CAST(f."XCL_020" AS REAL) * 100 / f."XCL_019" AS free_meal_pct
  FROM schools AS s
  INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s."XCL_041" = f."XCL_001"
  WHERE s."XCL_065" = 'Locally funded'
    AND s."XCL_063" = 1
    AND s."XCL_074" = 'K-8'
    AND f."XCL_019" > 0
),
avg_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(free_meal_pct) AS avg_free_meal_pct
  FROM qualifying_schools
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT q.*
  FROM qualifying_schools AS q
  CROSS JOIN avg_rate AS a
  WHERE q.free_meal_pct > a.avg_free_meal_pct
),
closed_counts AS (
  SELECT "XCL_045" AS county, COUNT("XCL_041") AS closed_count
  FROM schools
  WHERE "XCL_044" = 'Closed'
  GROUP BY "XCL_045"
),
top_county AS (
  SELECT county
  FROM closed_counts
  ORDER BY closed_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  a.school_name,
  a.city,
  a.free_meal_pct
FROM above_avg AS a
INNER JOIN top_county AS t ON a.county = t.county

WITH qualifying_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s."XCL_041" AS school_id,
    s."XCL_045" AS county,
    s."XCL_047" AS school_name,
    s."XCL_050" AS city,
    CAST(f."XCL_020" AS REAL) * 100 / f."XCL_019" AS free_meal_pct
  FROM schools AS s
  INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s."XCL_041" = f."XCL_001"
  WHERE s."XCL_065" = 'Locally funded'
    AND s."XCL_063" = 1
    AND s."XCL_074" = 'K-8'
    AND f."XCL_019" > 0
),
avg_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(free_meal_pct) AS avg_free_meal_pct
  FROM qualifying_schools
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT q.*
  FROM qualifying_schools AS q
  CROSS JOIN avg_rate AS a
  WHERE q.free_meal_pct > a.avg_free_meal_pct
),
closed_counts AS (
  SELECT "XCL_045" AS county, COUNT("XCL_041") AS closed_count
  FROM schools
  WHERE "XCL_044" = 'Closed'
  GROUP BY "XCL_045"
),
top_county AS (
  SELECT county
  FROM closed_counts
  ORDER BY closed_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  a.school_name,
  a.city,
  a.free_meal_pct
FROM above_avg AS a
INNER JOIN top_county AS t ON a.county = t.county

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s."XCL_041" AS school_id,
    s."XCL_043" AS school_name,
    s."XCL_044" AS city,
    s."XCL_045" AS county,
    CAST(f."XCL_020" AS REAL) * 100 / f."XCL_019" AS free_meal_pct
  FROM schools s
  INNER JOIN frpm f ON s."XCL_041" = f."XCL_001"
  WHERE s."XCL_044" = 'Closed'
    AND s."XCL_042" = 'C'
    AND s."XCL_065" = 'Locally funded'
    AND s."XCL_074" = 'K'
    AND s."XCL_075" = '8'
),
avg_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(free_meal_pct) AS avg_pct FROM base
),
above AS (
  SELECT b.*
  FROM base b
  CROSS JOIN avg_calc a
  WHERE b.free_meal_pct > a.avg_pct
),
top_county AS (
  SELECT county
  FROM above
  GROUP BY county
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  a.school_name,
  a.city,
  a.free_meal_pct
FROM above a
INNER JOIN top_county t ON a.county = t.county

  GROUP BY "XCL_045"
),
top_county AS (
  SELECT county
  FROM closed_counts
  ORDER BY closed_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

  a.school_name,
  a.city,
  a.free_meal_pct
FROM above_avg AS a
INNER JOIN top_county AS t ON a.county = t.county
